item: NH4Br: mp-23675 (P4/nmm, 12 atoms) vs mp-36248 (P-43m, 6 atoms)

data.phase_names: III (P4/nmm antiparallel) and IV (P-43m parallel); spg to label assignment from background, not a source
data.experimental_status: both real; III below T_lambda 235 K (10.1016/j.saa.2007.11.030) or 234 K (10.1016/j.saa.2007.10.053), metastable above RT in ND4Br; IV pressure-induced, sluggish (Funnell 10.1088/1361-648X/ac730b); II,IV,V,VI to 70 GPa, V to VI ~57.8 GPa (10.1063/1.4927782)
data.deuterated_studies: Funnell 2022 ND4Br neutron; Zhao 2023 (10.1021/acs.jpcc.3c05692, arXiv 2405.15277) 16% D, ordering at 247 K, warming 262/282 K, metastable to 310 K cited
data.known_isotope_effect: transition T shift ~+12 K (247 vs 235 K); no III/IV relative stability shift found
data.novelty: H/D effects on ordering measured, pair relative stability not found; Funnell full text unread
data.verdict_reason: orientational order-disorder and reorientation kinetics dominate; harmonic ddF_iso -0.57 meV/atom; fallback known_effect
